title: Felix and the Protocol
author: Quentin Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Thackeray, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
